author: Yffe
content:
Stage 6 added (commit 7889292): security-by-construction / information-flow control. 3-axis IFC (Tainted/Secret/Authorized) + the sink catalog (SQL/shell/path/HTML/net/log) + audited doors (sanitize/declassify/authorize = the security TCB, greppable + manifest-enumerated). Centerpiece grounded: the SQLi path query(raw Tainted) -> E0308, does NOT compile; parameterized version certifies; secret-leak + missing-cap also fail to compile (verus: 3 + 6 verified). Split pinned: sink CONTRACT verus-checkable now; mark-PROPAGATION engine = new validator-dataflow work (REQ-4). v1 line: explicit data-flow + 3 fixed axes; implicit/control-flow leaks, constant-time/side-channels, TOCTOU, full-lattice IFC OUT (the known IFC hard-spots — honest limit).

ROADMAP NOW (all 6 stages DESIGN-COMPLETE + verus-grounded, under .design/basis/; BUILD pending):
1 ADTs (keystone) | 2 recursion schemes | 3 effect stdlib | 4 collections | 5 composition | 6 security/IFC.
Dependency chain: 1 -> (2,4) -> (5,6); 3 mostly independent. Build sequence starts at Stage 1 (unblocks all). Each build = doc-author-refine -> builder -> critic loop. Unifying principle folded across all: handled-or-loud (every modeled outcome -> proven|checked|loud-refusal, never silently-wrong).
